get merged into one line and all leading spaces of all lines

Returns the absolute (positive) value of the given number.
If the given number is absolute, the given number is returned.
konkrete.placeholders.absolute_path.desc:
Returns the absolute path
of a file/folder.
konkrete.placeholders.alternating_case_t:
Converts the input text to alternating case.

Example:
Input: alternating case
Output: aLtErNaTiNg CaSe
konkrete.placeholders.base64_decode.desc:
Decodes a Base64 string back to text.

Required values:
- text: The Base64 string to decode
konkrete.placeholders.base64_encode.desc:
Encodes the given text to Base64.

Required values:
- text: The text to encode
konkrete.placeholders.calc.desc:
Solves arithmetic expressions.

Just replace the example expression
with the real one.

Set 'decimal' to 'false' if the
placeholder should return a LONG
instead of a DOUBLE.
Returns the clicks per second (CPS) for the given mouse button.

Required values:

Returns the current text content of the system's clipboard
or an empty text if nothing is currently stored in the clipboard.
konkrete.placeholders.crop_text.desc:
Removes a specific amount of characters from the
beginning and end of the given text.

text = The text to crop.
remove_from_start = Characters to remove from the beginning.
remove_from_end = Characters to remove from the end.
konkrete.placeholders.desc:
Add placeholders to the text that later
get replaced with values like the
player name or the Minecraft version.
konkrete.placeholders.file_md5.desc:
Returns the MD5 hash of a local file.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns an empty string if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
konkrete.placeholders.file_size.desc:
Returns the size of a local file in bytes.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns 0 if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
konkrete.placeholders.file_text.desc:
Reads text from a local file or remote URL and returns it.
Supports reading entire content or only the last few lines.

Content is cached to improve performance:
- Local files: Re-read every 1 second
- URLs: Re-read every 10 seconds

Required values:
- path_or_url: The file path or URL to read from
  Local files: Use a path inside the active Minecraft instance (e.g. 'config/myfile.txt')
  Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/data.txt')
  
The file path can start with '.minecraft/' to target the default .minecraft directory. Paths cannot leave either selected root.

Optional values:
- mode: How to read the content (default: 'all')
  Options: 'all' (entire content), 'last' (last X lines)
- separator: Text between lines when joining (default: '\n')
  Common options: '\n' (newline), ' | ', ', ', ' '
- last_lines: Number of lines to return in 'last' mode (default: 1)
  Only used when mode is 'last'

Note: When mode is 'last' with last_lines set to 1,
the single line is returned without any separator.

Returns empty string if source is not cached yet, doesn't exist,
cannot be read, or if there's no internet connection for URLs.

§xSecurity: Imported customizations can use this placeholder to read files inside these roots and combine the result with network actions. Only import customizations you trust, and inspect their placeholders and actions first.
konkrete.placeholders.guiheight.desc: The height of the current screen.
konkrete.placeholders.guiwidth.desc: The width of the current screen.
konkrete.placeholders.json.desc:
Parse JSON and get a value from it.

The 'source' value accepts:
- Direct JSON content (e.g. {"key":"value"})
- A local JSON file inside the active Minecraft instance
- A URL to a remote JSON file

Local paths cannot leave the active instance directory. Replace '$.some.json.path' with the JSON path to read.

§xSecurity: Imported content can use this placeholder to read JSON inside the instance and combine it with network-enabled features. Only import content you trust.
konkrete.placeholders.jvm_cpu_usage.desc: Gets the current CPU usage of the Java Virtual Machine.
konkrete.placeholders.jvm_name.desc: The name of the Java Virtual Machine.
konkrete.placeholders.kebab_case_text.de:
Converts the input text to kebab-case.

Example:
Input: Hello World
Output: hello-world
konkrete.placeholders.last_death_message: Shows the latest death message you received. Set "as_json_component" to true to return the serialized text component instead of plain text.
Returns the last world or server the player joined.
You can control via the 'type' value if the placeholder
should return both servers and worlds or only one of them.

Types: both, world, server

The 'full_world_path' value controls if the full path or
only the name of the world (not server) should get returned.
Setting this to 'false' will only return the world name.
konkrete.placeholders.loaded_mods.desc:
Gets the active mods count.
This doesn't include disabled mods.
konkrete.placeholders.loader_name.desc: Gets the name of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
konkrete.placeholders.loader_version.des: Gets the version of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
konkrete.placeholders.local.desc:
Localizes text using the supplied translation key.

Replace 'localization.key' with a Minecraft, resource-pack, or mod translation key.
konkrete.placeholders.lowercase_text.des:
Converts the input text to lowercase letters.

Example:
Input: HELLO WORLD
Output: hello world
konkrete.placeholders.math_ceil.desc:
Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.
For example, ceil(3.14) = 4 and ceil(-3.14) = -3.
konkrete.placeholders.math_cos.desc: Returns the trigonometric cosine of an angle.
konkrete.placeholders.math_cosh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a double value.
konkrete.placeholders.math_floor.desc:
Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.
For example, floor(3.14) = 3 and floor(-3.14) = -4.
konkrete.placeholders.math_round.desc:
Rounds a number.
Set the optional 'decimals' value to control the decimal place (use 0 or -1 round to an integer).
Example 1: num=3.14159 & decimals=2 -> 3.14.
Example 2: num=3.14159 & decimals=0 -> 3.
konkrete.placeholders.math_sign.desc:
Returns:
 1 if the number is positive
-1 if the number is negative
 0 if the number is zero
konkrete.placeholders.math_sin.desc: Returns the trigonometric sine of an angle.
konkrete.placeholders.math_sinh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a double value.
konkrete.placeholders.math_tan.desc: Returns the trigonometric tangent of an angle.
konkrete.placeholders.math_tanh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a double value.
konkrete.placeholders.max_number.desc: Returns the greater of two numbers.
konkrete.placeholders.min_number.desc: Returns the smaller of two numbers.
konkrete.placeholders.minecraft_option_v:
Gets the current value of a Minecraft option.
For a list of valid option names, take a look at
the 'options.txt' file of your Minecraft instance.
konkrete.placeholders.modversion.desc:
Gets the version of a mod by its mod ID.

Just replace 'some_mod_id' in the placeholder
with an existing mod ID.
konkrete.placeholders.mouseposx.desc:
Gets the mouse X position.

§xAlways returns 10 while in the editor,
§xso you can still edit the element
§xwithout it following your mouse when
§xusing it for advanced sizing/positioning.
konkrete.placeholders.mouseposy.desc:
Gets the mouse Y position.

§xAlways returns 10 while in the editor,
§xso you can still edit the element
§xwithout it following your mouse when
§xusing it for advanced sizing/positioning.
konkrete.placeholders.nbt_data_get.clien:
Reads NBT directly from the client's world state.
Supports entity selectors with type/name/tag/limit/sort/distance/x/y/z/dx/dy/dz options,
plus absolute or relative block positions, returning value,
string, or SNBT formats entirely client-side.
konkrete.placeholders.nbt_data_get.serve:
§xRequires Konkrete on the server.§r

Fetches live NBT data from the server for every target supported by '/data get'. Returns an empty value until the server response arrives.

Supported source_type values:
- entity: Full selector syntax
- block: Absolute, relative (~), or local (^) coordinates
- storage: Command storage identifiers (namespace:key)

Optional arguments:
- nbt_path: Same path rules as '/data get'
- scale: Multiplies numeric results (default 1.0)
- return_type: 'value', 'string', 'snbt', or 'json'

Responses are cached briefly to avoid excessive server requests.
konkrete.placeholders.negate_number.desc:
Returns the negation of the given number.
If the given number is negative, the given number is returned.
konkrete.placeholders.number_base_conver:
Converts a number between bases (supports decimals).
Values: input, from_base (2-36), to_base (2-36).
Up to 16 fractional digits are generated in the target base.
Example: input=67, from_base=10, to_base=2 -> 1000011.
konkrete.placeholders.os.desc: The name of the Operating System.
konkrete.placeholders.os_cpu_usage.desc: Gets the current CPU usage of the Operating System.
konkrete.placeholders.pi.desc: Returns the double value that is closer than any other to §opi§r, the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter.
konkrete.placeholders.random_number.desc:
Returns a random number in the specified range.
Returns a different number every tick,
so it's recommended to use the
placeholder in combination with
a variable or something else to
control the refresh rate.
konkrete.placeholders.randomtext.desc:
Picks a random line from a text file, URL, or direct plain text.

The source may be a path inside the active Minecraft instance, an HTTP/HTTPS URL, or direct text with lines separated by '\n'. Content is refreshed periodically.

The 'interval' value controls how often a new line is selected in seconds. An interval of 0 selects only once per session.
konkrete.placeholders.realtime_hour.desc:
Returns the current real-world hour.
Defaults to 24-hour format (00-23).

Values:
- twelve_hour_format: Set to 'true' to return 12-hour format instead (01-12)
- timezone: Timezone to use for this placeholder. Defaults to 'system'. It is recommended to use IANA timezone IDs here. A good website to see all IANA IDs is https://nodatime.org/TimeZones
konkrete.placeholders.replace_text.desc:
Replaces text in a string using either literal text or regular expressions (regex).
Supports both single replacement and replace-all operations.

Required values:
- text: The input text to perform replacements on
- search: The text or regex pattern to search for

Optional values:
- replacement: The replacement text (default: empty string)
- use_regex: Set to 'true' to use regex patterns (default: 'false')
- replace_all: Set to 'true' to replace all occurrences, otherwise only first occurrence (default: 'true')

When using regex, you can use capture groups like $1, $2, etc.
Returns the identifier of the screen that is currently open. Returns an empty value if no screen is open.
konkrete.placeholders.sentence_case_text:
Converts input text to sentence case.

Example:
Input: hello world. this is konkrete!
Output: Hello world. This is konkrete!
konkrete.placeholders.servermotd.desc:
Gets the MOTD of a server.
Just replace 'someserver.com:25565'
with the actual server IP
and '1' with the MOTD line.
MOTDs only have 2 lines, so
the only valid line values are
'1' and '2'.
konkrete.placeholders.serverping.desc:
Gets the ping to a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
Gets the player count of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
konkrete.placeholders.serverstatus.desc:
Gets the status (online/offline) of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
konkrete.placeholders.serverversion.desc:
Gets the MC version of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
konkrete.placeholders.snake_case_text.de:
Converts the input text to snake_case.

Example:
Input: Hello World
Output: hello_world
konkrete.placeholders.split_text.desc:
Splits a text at a specific character or regex.

input = The text to split.
regex = The character or regex for where to split the text.
max_parts = The max parts the text should get split into. Setting this to -1 disables the limit.
split_index = The part that should get returned after splitting. Starts at 0.
konkrete.placeholders.stringify.desc:
Stringifies a text by escaping all
syntax characters ( " { } ).

This is useful when nesting other
placeholders as value. If the
replaced nested placeholder could
contain syntax characters that aren't
part of another placeholder, you need
to escape them.

§xPlaceholders in the value will be
§xreplaced first, so you don't need
§xto worry about them getting stringified.
konkrete.placeholders.switch_case.desc:
Matches a value against multiple cases and returns the corresponding result.
Format: value to match, case pairs (value:result) separated by commas, optional default case.
Example: value="1", cases="1:first,2:second", default="none"
konkrete.placeholders.text_char_count.de: Returns the character count of the given text.
konkrete.placeholders.text_width.desc:
Returns the width in pixels of the given text.
Useful for calculating element positions or sizes based on text width.
konkrete.placeholders.title_case_text.de:
Converts the input text to Title Case.

Example:
Input: hello world
Output: Hello World
konkrete.placeholders.toggle_case_text.d:
Toggles the case of each letter in the input text.

Example:

Output: tOGGLE cASE
konkrete.placeholders.totalmods.desc:
Gets the total mods count.

konkrete.placeholders.trim_text.desc:
Removes all leading and trailing spaces of the
given text, but not spaces within the text.
konkrete.placeholders.uppercase_text.des:
Converts the input text to uppercase letters.

Example:
Input: Hello World

konkrete.placeholders.uptime_seconds.des: Returns the time since the game launched in seconds or, if "output_as_millis" is true, in milliseconds.
konkrete.placeholders.webtext.desc:
Gets the first line of
plain text content from a website.

Replace 'http://somewebsite.com/textfile.txt'
with the link to the page you
want to get the text from.
konkrete.placeholders.world.action_bar_m:

Returns an empty text when no action bar message is displayed.

Returns the camera Y rotation as value between -180.0 and 180.0 (degrees).

konkrete.placeholders.world.current_boss:

konkrete.placeholders.world.current_dime:
Returns the dimension the player is in.

konkrete.placeholders.world.current_moun:

Returns the current world's difficulty.

konkrete.placeholders.world.effects_coun:

konkrete.placeholders.world.highlighted_: The time left in ticks that the original vanilla highlighted item name gets displayed above the hotbar.
konkrete.placeholders.world.hovered_inve:
Returns the key of the hovered item in the currently open inventory.
Returns an empty value when no inventory is open or no item is hovered.
konkrete.placeholders.world.inventory_it:

konkrete.placeholders.world.level_save_d:
Returns the complete level data of a specific world save as single-line JSON.

konkrete.placeholders.world.level_save_n:

konkrete.placeholders.world.max_player_a:

konkrete.placeholders.world.max_player_h:
Returns the max health of the player.

Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.max_player_o:

Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_armor:
Returns the total armor toughness value of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_attac:
Returns the current attack strength of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_gamem:
Returns the current game mode of the player.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: survival, creative, adventure, spectator
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_item_:
Returns the current item use progress of the player.
This is, for example, the progress of eating food, drinking a potion, drawing a bow, etc.
The returned value is a decimal between 0.0 (0%) and 1.0 (100%).
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_posit:
Displays the change in player position along the X axis between ticks as a decimal value.
The value can be positive or negative.

Displays the change in player position along the Y axis between ticks as a decimal value.
The value can be positive or negative.

Displays the change in player position along the Z axis between ticks as a decimal value.

konkrete.placeholders.world.player_view_:
Returns the player's view direction.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: north, east, south, west
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_x_coo:
Returns the X coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_y_coo:
Returns the Y coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.player_z_coo:
Returns the Z coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.players_list:
Returns a list of all players currently in the world.
Player names are sorted alphabetically.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate player names (default: ', ')
konkrete.placeholders.world.slot_item.de:
Returns the key of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
konkrete.placeholders.world.slot_item_co:
Returns the item count of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.

konkrete.placeholders.world.slot_item_di:

Values:

Konkrete detected that the FMA '%s' likely contains expensive frame images.

At least one sampled frame uses 16-bit PNG color depth instead of normal 8-bit color depth.

16-bit PNG frames are much more expensive to decode and can cause animation lag or very low playback FPS while the FMA is playing.

To fix this, convert the FMA frame images to normal 8-bit PNG files and then rebuild the FMA archive.
konkrete.resources.source_type.local.des:
This source type loads files confined to the active
Minecraft instance directory. The explicit '.minecraft/'
prefix targets the default Minecraft directory instead.
The configured local resource root is also available.
Only select resources from locations you trust.
This source type uses Minecraft's own resource
system to get resources, so in other words,
it can use resources of resource packs,
Vanilla Minecraft and mods.

Enter the resource location to use.
Resource locations contain a namespace and path
separated by a colon (:), for example
'minecraft:textures/gui/title/minecraft.png'.
konkrete.resources.source_type.web.desc:
This source type lets you use web resources via URL.
Resource URLs should ALWAYS be DIRECT URLs,
which means they should point directly to the
resource and end with the resource's name + extension.
URLs also need to start with http:// or https://.

§xUsing non-direct URLs will hurt the performance!
